abstract: We demonstrate how private equity (PE) promotes nonbank lending by substituting for bank monitoring. Relative to non-PE-backed loans, PE-backed loans exhibit lower bank monitoring, smaller loan shares retained by lead banks, and larger shares held by nonbanks. The substitution is strongest when sponsors have greater incentives to engage with portfolio firms, is not associated with weaker loan performance, and persists during borrower distress. Our findings suggest that PE sponsors’ active engagement—through monitoring and support in distress—reduces banks’ need for monitoring and information production, enabling them to retain less skin in the game and sell loans to nonbanks.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了私募股权（PE）如何通过替代银行监督来促进非银行贷款。相对于非PE支持的贷款，PE支持的贷款表现出更低的银行监督、牵头银行保留的贷款份额更小，以及非银行持有的份额更大。当发起人有更强的动机参与投资组合公司时，这种替代效应最强，且不与更差的贷款表现相关联，并在借款人困境期间持续存在。我们的发现表明，PE发起人的积极参与——通过在困境中的监督和支持——降低了银行对监督和信息生产的需求，使其能够保留更少的切身利益并将贷款出售给非银行。
title: How Private Equity Fuels Nonbank Lending
title_zh: 私募股权如何推动非银行借贷

abstract: How does technology adoption in developing countries influence firms' use of flexible, low‐protection labour when local demand fluctuates? This paper studies how computer capital intensity moderates firms' use of contract workers in response to exogenous, weather‐driven demand shocks. Using panel data on Indian manufacturing firms from 1999–2000 to 2009–2010, we combine firm‐level information on computer capital stocks with district‐level rainfall shocks that shift agricultural incomes and, in turn, local demand for manufacturing goods. We find that in response to positive transitory demand shocks, firms with above‐average computer capital shares hire 2.32 fewer contract workers than those with below‐average shares, representing an 11.33% difference relative to mean contract employment. This effect primarily impacts workers in manufacturing activities rather than peripheral services. Our results remain robust across various alternative measures of computer capital intensity, including exogenous measures derived from the industry‐level US computer capital expenditure distribution, as well as the inclusion of additional controls for firm‐specific time‐varying characteristics. The results show that computer‐capital‐intensive firms adjust contract employment less in response to transitory demand shocks, highlighting how early‐stage computerization, flexible labour arrangements, and weather‐induced demand fluctuations jointly shape labour demand in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家技术采用如何影响企业在本地需求波动时对灵活、低保障劳动力的使用？本文研究计算机资本密集度如何调节企业应对外生、天气驱动的需求冲击时对合同工的使用。利用1999—2000年至2009—2010年印度制造业企业面板数据，我们将企业层面计算机资本存量信息与地区层面降雨冲击相结合，后者会改变农业收入，进而改变本地对制造业产品的需求。我们发现，在应对正向暂时性需求冲击时，计算机资本份额高于平均水平的企业比低于平均水平的企业少雇佣2.32名合同工，相对于合同就业均值而言差异为11.33%。这一效应主要影响从事制造活动的工人，而非外围服务人员。我们的结果在多种计算机资本密集度的替代衡量指标下保持稳健，包括由行业层面美国计算机资本支出分布衍生的外生指标，以及加入企业特定时变特征的额外控制变量。结果表明，计算机资本密集型企业对暂时性需求冲击的合同就业调整更少，凸显了早期计算机化、灵活劳动安排与天气引致的需求波动如何共同塑造发展中经济体的劳动需求。
title: Do clouds have a silicon lining for firms? Contract hiring and computer capital: evidence from rainfall shocks
title_zh: 企业能否从云中获益？合同雇佣与计算机资本：来自降雨冲击的证据

abstract: This paper investigates whether the well‐documented border and distance puzzles in trade also apply to international migration. Using a gravity model framework, we explore the evolving role of borders and distance as barriers to migration in a globalized world. Our approach accounts for internal migration, addresses multilateral resistance to migration in alternative ways, and incorporates network effects along with international trade, investment and labour mobility agreements. The analysis covers a comprehensive dataset of bilateral migration flows and internal mobility for over 16,000 country pairs from 1995 to 2020. The results show that while the distance effect on migration has diminished over time, consistent with the reduction of frictions in a globalized world, the border puzzle persists, with borders continuing to act as significant barriers to migration. Sensitivity tests using alternative dependent variables, such as migration stocks and rates, confirm the robustness of these findings. The general gravity model, which accounts for origin and destination‐specific nests, provides a better fit and appears to resolve the distance puzzle by capturing the complexities of multilateral resistance to migration. However, the persistence of the border effect highlights the ongoing relevance of international borders in shaping global migration flows.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了贸易中已被充分记录的边界与距离之谜是否同样适用于国际移民。本文运用引力模型框架，探讨在全球化世界中边界与距离作为移民障碍的演变作用。本文的方法将国内迁移纳入考量，以替代方式处理对移民的多边阻力，并将网络效应与国际贸易、投资和劳动力流动协定一并纳入。分析覆盖1995年至2020年间超过16000对国家组合的双边移民流动与国内流动的综合数据集。结果表明，尽管距离对移民的影响随时间推移而减弱，这与全球化世界中摩擦的减少相一致，但边界之谜依然存在，边界继续成为移民的重要障碍。使用替代因变量（如移民存量和移民率）进行的敏感性检验证实了这些发现的稳健性。一般引力模型考虑了来源地和目的地特定的嵌套结构，提供了更好的拟合，并似乎通过捕捉对移民的多边阻力的复杂性解决了距离之谜。然而，边界效应的持续性凸显了国际边界在塑造全球移民流动方面持续具有的相关性。
title: Has the World Become Smaller for Migrants? The Border and Distance Puzzles in Migration
title_zh: 世界对移民而言变小了吗？移民中的边界与距离之谜

abstract: In countries characterized by significant geographical disparities in productivity, nationwide labour contracts may cause local unemployment by preventing the adjustments that would occur in a competitive labour market. Here we argue, however, that when there are mobility frictions and monopsony power, nationwide contracts may still be preferable to local contracts. Using a spatial general equilibrium model calibrated on the Italian North-South divide, we suggest that nationwide wage contracts may still lead to narrower regional welfare gaps if monopsony power is sufficiently strong in low-productivity areas.
abstract_zh: 在生产率存在显著地理差异的国家，全国性劳动合同可能通过阻止竞争性劳动力市场中本会发生的调整而导致地方失业。然而，我们认为，当存在流动性摩擦和买方垄断力量时，全国性合同可能仍优于地方性合同。使用一个以意大利南北差距为校准基准的空间一般均衡模型，我们表明，如果低生产率地区的买方垄断力量足够强，全国性工资合同仍可能带来更小的区域福利差距。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: National Wage Contracts, Monopsony, and Welfare in a North-South Economy*,†
title_zh: 国家工资合同、买方垄断与南北经济中的福利

abstract: This paper examines how network ties between local social leaders influenced the diffusion of mass protests in an autocracy. We focus on the Protestant Church and the Peaceful Revolution in East Germany. To quantify the role of leader networks in protest diffusion, we compile biographical records of over 1,600 Protestant pastors and construct network ties based on shared employment histories. Our findings reveal that network connections led to an increase in protest diffusion by 7.1 percentage points in a given week. Evidence from quasi-random connections, placebo networks, and an IV strategy supports a causal interpretation of these results.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了地方社会领袖之间的网络联系如何影响威权体制下大规模抗议的扩散。我们聚焦于新教教会与东德和平革命。为量化领袖网络在抗议扩散中的作用，我们整理了1600多名新教牧师的传记记录，并基于共同的任职经历构建网络联系。研究发现，网络连接使特定一周内抗议扩散的概率提高了7.1个百分点。来自准随机联系、安慰剂网络和工具变量策略的证据支持对这些结果的因果解释。
title: Networks of Dissent: Social Leaders and Protest in an Autocracy*
title_zh: 异见网络：威权政体中的社会领袖与抗议

abstract: We extend the immigration surplus results of Borjas (1995). In a closed competitive constant-returns economy, we show that an influx of migrants (holding their skill mix fixed) must increase the total real income of natives, for any number of factor inputs, any pattern of substitutability or complementarity between them, and any number of intermediate or final goods – with larger gains if natives and migrants differ more in skill mix. If natives supply labour elastically across skill types, their welfare gains are diminished, even if they respond by moving to higher-paying jobs. We illustrate our results using a US calibration.
abstract_zh: 我们扩展了Borjas（1995）的移民剩余结果。在一个封闭的竞争性恒定回报经济中，我们证明，移民流入（保持其技能组合不变）必然增加本地居民的总实际收入，无论要素投入数量多少、它们之间替代性或互补性的模式如何，以及中间产品或最终产品的数量多少——如果本地居民与移民在技能组合上的差异越大，收益就越大。如果本地居民在不同技能类型间弹性供给劳动，他们的福利增益会减少，即使他们通过转向更高薪酬的工作来回应。我们使用美国校准来展示我们的结果。
title: The Immigration Surplus Revisited
title_zh: 重访移民剩余

abstract: Based on China’s city-level panel data from 2005 to 2023, this paper empirically investigates the nonlinear impact of agricultural FDI firm agglomeration on agricultural economic resilience using quadratic regression and a two-line test on both sides of the turning point. The results reveal a significant inverted U-shaped relationship between agricultural FDI firm agglomeration and agricultural economic resilience, which is more prominent in major grain-consuming regions. The conclusion remains robust after addressing endogeneity, spatial effects, and multiple robustness checks. Mechanism analysis indicates that technological upgrading and optimized resource allocation efficiency are the main transmission channels. At present, China’s agricultural FDI firm agglomeration is still on the left side of the inverted U-curve, and appropriately raising the agglomeration level can further strengthen agricultural economic resilience. The findings provide important empirical support for optimizing the spatial layout of foreign investment, and enhancing agricultural economic resilience.

abstract: We examine how an expanded set of features, including local supply chain and weather data, affect delta-hedged soybean meal option returns in China. For the selected nonlinear ensemble, the full predictor set produces an out-of-sample R2 of 11.2%. Option characteristics contain most of the predictive information, while supply chain and weather variables provide additional information beyond option and futures predictors. Predictive performance is higher when geopolitical risk and investor attention are low. Weather information is particularly valuable during the local soybean growing season, when it delivers stronger out-of-sample predictive gains. Finally, we show that these forecasts can generate profitable trading strategies; however, this economic viability is highly conditional. Specifically, it heavily depends on applying strict threshold rules to manage market frictions.

abstract: Drawing on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2012 to 2023, this article investigates whether biodiversity risk is associated with corporate green M&A decisions. We construct a firm-year measure of biodiversity risk reflected in annual reports using an LLM-assisted textual approach and identify green M&As from transaction disclosures. Baseline Probit estimates reveal a positive and statistically significant association between biodiversity risk and the likelihood of green M&A. The result remains robust across a wide range of additional tests, including propensity score matching and instrumental-variable analysis. Further analyses identify financing constraints and corporate reputation as two potential channels underlying this relationship. Consistent with differences in risk materiality, firms’ incentives to respond, and their capacity to act, the positive association is stronger among firms with higher supplier concentration, greater green investor involvement, and larger boards, respectively. By contrast, biodiversity risk is not significantly associated with non-green M&A or subsequent green patenting, indicating that the documented relationship is specific to green acquisition decisions in our setting.
abstract_zh: 本文基于2012年至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，考察生物多样性风险是否与企业绿色并购决策相关。我们采用LLM辅助的文本分析方法构建了反映年度报告中生物多样性风险的企业—年度指标，并从交易披露中识别绿色并购。基准Probit估计结果显示，生物多样性风险与绿色并购的可能性之间存在正向且统计显著的关联。该结果在包括倾向得分匹配和工具变量分析在内的一系列广泛附加检验中保持稳健。进一步分析识别出融资约束和企业声誉是这一关系背后的两个潜在渠道。与风险重要性、企业响应动机及其行动能力的差异相一致，这一正向关联分别在供应商集中度较高、绿色投资者参与度较高以及董事会规模较大的企业中更强。相比之下，生物多样性风险与非绿色并购或后续绿色专利申请均无显著关联，表明所记录的关系在我们的研究情境中特定于绿色收购决策。

abstract: The integration of the Communist Party of China leadership into enterprise governance is a crucial sustainable‑development strategy, playing an irreplaceable role in the green transition of high-polluting enterprises. In this study, we investigate the causal effect of political foresighted leading (PFL) on green transition and its potential channels. The empirical results show that such leading significantly drives enterprises’ green transition. We also find that improving green‑governance efficiency, internal-control capability and green‑resource investment are the main channels. Further analysis documents that PFL is particularly effective in collaboration with media attention and green production, highlighting a collective effort to promote green transition. Our paper provides theoretical validation for the pivotal role of PFL in promoting green transition and underscores its importance in enterprise development beyond the mere presence of Party leadership.
abstract_zh: 中国共产党领导融入企业治理是一项关键的可持续发展战略，在高污染企业绿色转型中发挥着不可替代的作用。本研究考察政治前瞻性引领（PFL）对绿色转型的因果效应及其潜在渠道。实证结果表明，这种引领显著驱动企业绿色转型。我们还发现，提升绿色治理效率、内部控制能力和绿色资源投入是主要渠道。进一步分析表明，PFL与媒体关注和绿色生产协同尤为有效，凸显了促进绿色转型的集体努力。本文为PFL在促进绿色转型中的关键作用提供了理论验证，并强调了其在企业发展中的重要性，超越了仅仅存在党组织领导的意义。

title: Political foresighted leading and green transition

abstract: This paper documents post-earnings announcement drift (PEAD) in corporate bond prices using transaction data. We find a counterintuitive relationship between the drift and trading volume: PEAD is more pronounced for more heavily traded bonds than for less frequently traded bonds. Across markets, PEAD is observed for credit default swaps but not for stocks. We explain these findings using a unified model that incorporates both debt and equity trading, where investors possess private information about the underlying firm’s cash flows and may hold differing opinions. Our empirical evidence supports the model’s prediction that payoff structures and investor disagreement account for the distinct price dynamics across asset classes. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: The authors acknowledge research support from the Center for Investing at HKUST. Y. Xiong thanks the support by National Natural Science Foundation of China [NSFC 72422007] and the Research Grants Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China [Project 16501523]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07966 .
abstract_zh: 本文利用交易数据记录了公司债券价格中的盈余公告后漂移（PEAD）现象。我们发现漂移与交易量之间存在一个反直觉的关系：PEAD在交易更活跃的债券中比在交易较不频繁的债券中更为显著。跨市场来看，PEAD在信用违约互换中被观察到，但在股票中未被观察到。我们用一个统一模型来解释这些发现，该模型同时纳入债务与股权交易，其中投资者拥有关于标的公司现金流的私有信息，并可能持有不同意见。我们的实证证据支持模型的预测，即收益结构和投资者分歧解释了不同资产类别之间截然不同的价格动态。本文由金融领域编辑Lukas Schmid接收。资助：作者感谢香港科技大学投资研究中心的研究支持。熊伟感谢国家自然科学基金[NSFC 72422007]以及中国香港特别行政区研究资助局[项目16501523]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07966获取。

abstract: Firms are often allowed to sell new drugs based on preliminary efficacy evidence, with final approval contingent on confirmatory testing. We characterize optimal approval policies for a government agency that maximizes consumer welfare while considering the firm’s incentives. We assume that firms have private information about testing costs and the government’s payoff depends on the drug’s expected efficacy. The optimal policy may include partial conditional approval for drugs with low expected efficacy, and leniency in granting final approval below conventional standards. Our calibration suggests these tools can generate hundreds of millions of dollars in annual social value. This paper was accepted by Martin Bichler, market design, platform, and demand analytics. Funding: The authors received no external funding for this research. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03836 .
abstract_zh: 企业常被允许基于初步疗效证据销售新药，最终批准取决于确证性试验。我们刻画了政府机构在考虑企业激励的同时最大化消费者福利的最优批准政策。我们假设企业拥有关于试验成本的私人信息，且政府收益取决于药物的预期疗效。最优政策可能包括对预期疗效较低药物给予部分条件批准，以及在低于传统标准的情况下宽松地授予最终批准。我们的校准表明，这些工具每年可产生数亿美元的社会价值。本文由Martin Bichler（市场设计、平台与需求分析领域）接受。资助：作者未获得本研究的外部资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03836获取。

abstract: An asset owner designs an asset-backed security and a signal about its value. After experiencing a liquidity shock and privately observing the signal, he sells the security to imperfectly competitive buyers. With flexible information design, the security’s informational sensitivity is a blessing, not a curse. Among double-monotone securities, the issuer prefers to sell the asset in combination with an appropriate signal rather than design more complex securities. Within the class of monotone securities, live-or-die securities are optimal and strictly dominate asset sales. When signals are restricted to be sufficiently informative about the upside, debt and additional-tier-1 debt become optimal. (JEL D82, D86, G32)
abstract_zh: 资产所有者设计一种资产支持证券及其价值信号。在经历流动性冲击并私下观察到该信号后，他将证券出售给不完全竞争的买家。在灵活的信息设计下，证券的信息敏感性是福而非祸。在双单调证券中，发行人更倾向于将资产与适当的信号结合出售，而非设计更复杂的证券。在单调证券类别中，生存或死亡证券是最优的，并严格优于资产出售。当信号被限制为对上行空间具有足够信息量时，债务和额外一级债务成为最优选择。(JEL D82, D86, G32)
title: Optimal Information and Security Design
title_zh: 最优信息与安全设计

abstract: A Bayesian factor-augmented interacted vector autoregression framework purified of expectations is employed to analyze how government spending shocks have impacted CO 2 emissions in the United States from the 1980s to the pre-pandemic period. Consumption-generated emissions are found to have generally risen following fiscal expansions, although their elasticity to government spending has declined substantially over time—with the five-year elasticity dropping from about 0.6 in the early 1980s to around zero by 2019. In contrast, positive government spending shocks increased production-generated emissions in the early 1980s — with a five-year elasticity near 0.5 — but reversed course by the end of the 1980s, eventually reaching an elasticity of −0.7 by the end of the sample. Examination of time-varying interaction variables suggests that environmental regulation, tertiarization, and a larger share of spending on public goods are associated with a mitigation — or even a reversal — of the emissions growth related to economic expansions driven by government spending. The income channel plays a more limited role, mostly confined to the earlier part of the sample. Furthermore, government consumption and investment are both associated with these shifts in emissions elasticities.
abstract_zh: 本文采用一个剔除预期因素的贝叶斯因子增广交互向量自回归框架，分析20世纪80年代至疫情前美国政府支出冲击如何影响二氧化碳排放。研究发现，财政扩张后，消费产生的排放总体上有所上升，但其对政府支出的弹性随时间显著下降——五年期弹性从20世纪80年代初的约0.6降至2019年的接近零。相比之下，正向政府支出冲击在20世纪80年代初提高了生产产生的排放——五年期弹性接近0.5——但到20世纪80年代末出现逆转，最终在样本末期达到−0.7的弹性。对时变交互变量的考察表明，环境监管、第三产业化和公共品支出占比提高，与政府支出驱动的经济扩张相关排放增长的缓解——甚至逆转——相关联。收入渠道的作用较为有限，主要局限于样本前期。此外，政府消费和政府投资均与这些排放弹性的变化相关。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Time-varying impacts of government spending on CO2 emissions
title_zh: 政府支出对二氧化碳排放的时变影响

abstract: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy. This paper examines four channels of transmission of the Iran conflict to inflation in the EA, UK, and the US. The first is the transmission to the sticky prices in core sectors. Recent advances in menu cost models predict that inflation will rise faster than usual and monetary policy is less powerful to curb it. The second is transmission to spending, wages, and nominal returns through higher expected inflation. The empirical literature on household and firm inflation expectations points to some evidence for this amplification. The third channel is through other aggregate demand policies, especially fiscal policy. The IMF’s reassessments of the fiscal outlook provide some guarded grounds for optimism. The fourth mechanism is through an erosion in the credibility of the long-run inflation target. Data from market prices indicates that the inflation anchor has not moved. All combined, the data as of May 2026 suggests that the Iran war shock will have a significant impact on inflation that persists into 2027, but that is smaller and more short-lived than the 2021–24 inflation disaster.
abstract_zh: 能源成本的意外上涨通过灵活定价直接推高通胀。这一冲击是否会放大为更大且持续的通胀上升，取决于其在经济中的传导。本文考察伊朗冲突通过四条渠道向欧元区、英国和美国通胀的传导。第一条是向核心部门粘性价格的传导。菜单成本模型的最新进展预测，通胀将比通常上升得更快，货币政策抑制通胀的能力也更弱。第二条是通过更高的通胀预期向支出、工资和名义回报的传导。关于家庭和企业通胀预期的实证文献为这种放大效应提供了一些证据。第三条渠道是通过其他总需求政策，尤其是财政政策。国际货币基金组织对财政前景的重新评估提供了一些有保留的乐观依据。第四种机制是通过长期通胀目标可信度的侵蚀。市场价格数据表明，通胀锚并未移动。综合来看，截至2026年5月的数据表明，伊朗战争冲击将对通胀产生显著影响，并持续至2027年，但其影响比2021—24年的通胀灾难更小、更短暂。
title: Inflation after the Iran war
title_zh: 伊朗战争后的通货膨胀

abstract: Cross-border payments remain slow and expensive despite significant improvements in digital financial infrastructure over the past several decades. This paper compares the cost of sending cross-border payments across three payment rails: traditional banks operating through the correspondent banking system and SWIFT, fintech money trans fer operators (MTOs) such as Wise, Remitly, and the digital arm of Western Union, and stablecoin-based transfers. We construct harmonized all-in costs measures across these three rails for different corridors and payment values. We find that fintech MTOs have significantly compressed the costs of cross-border payments, and demonstrate that stablecoins are not a panacea for frictions in cross-border payments.
abstract_zh: 尽管过去几十年数字金融基础设施有了显著改善，跨境支付仍然缓慢且昂贵。本文比较了三种支付渠道的跨境支付成本：通过代理银行体系和SWIFT运营的传统银行、金融科技货币转移运营商（MTOs），如Wise、Remitly以及西联汇款的数字部门，以及基于稳定币的转账。我们针对不同走廊和支付金额，构建了这三种渠道的统一全成本衡量指标。我们发现，金融科技MTOs显著压缩了跨境支付成本，并证明稳定币并非解决跨境支付摩擦的万灵药。
china_relevance_reason: 研究比较银行、金融科技汇款运营商与稳定币的跨境支付成本，未涉及中国、中国企业、中国人群或中国制度背景，仅作者姓名疑似中文。
title: Competing rails for crossborder payments: banks, fintechs, and stablecoins
title_zh: 跨境支付的竞争性通道：银行、金融科技公司与稳定币

abstract: The increasing use of geoeconomic pressure is reshaping the global economy. We introduce a methodology using large language models (LLMs) to systematically measure the application of and response to geoeconomic pressure from large textual corpora, classifying which governments apply pressure to which foreign targets, using which in struments, firms, and products. Most importantly, we use LLMs to analyze how and why firms respond to the pressure. We focus on export controls, sanctions, and tariffs as the main instruments of pressure on firms. We find that export controls induce the targeted firms to undertake domestic R&D to build a domestic alternative technology. Western sanctions on Russia cause supply chain re-arrangements, the major beneficiary of which are firms in third-party countries, like China and India, which step into the market vacuum created by the broken business relationships. The threat and impositions of U.S. tariffs cause losses for the majority of U.S. firms, which report absorbing the cost shock on their inputs via their profit margin. Foreign firms are also negatively affected, mostly via the related macroeconomic uncertainty and the cost of relocating production.
abstract_zh: 地缘经济压力的日益使用正在重塑全球经济。我们引入一种方法，利用大语言模型（LLMs）从大型文本语料库中系统性地测量地缘经济压力的实施与应对，对哪些政府对哪些外国目标施加压力、使用哪些工具、企业和产品进行分类。最重要的是，我们使用LLMs分析企业如何以及为何应对压力。我们聚焦于出口管制、制裁和关税作为对企业施加压力的主要工具。我们发现，出口管制促使目标企业开展国内研发以构建国内替代技术。西方对俄罗斯的制裁导致供应链重新安排，其主要受益者是第三方国家的企业，如中国和印度，它们填补了因商业关系破裂而创造的市场真空。美国关税的威胁和实施给大多数美国企业造成损失，这些企业报告通过其利润率吸收了投入品的成本冲击。外国企业也受到负面影响，主要通过相关的宏观经济不确定性和生产迁移成本。
china_relevance_reason: 核心研究对象是地缘经济压力（出口管制、制裁、关税）对企业的影响，中国仅在摘要中作为第三方受益国之一被顺带提及，并非核心研究对象、数据或制度背景。
title: Geoeconomic pressure
title_zh: 地缘经济压力

abstract: This study examines how global value chain (GVC) integration is associated with greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI)-induced job creation across EU-27 country-sector pairs. We combine project-level fDi Markets employment data with TiVA-based GVC indicators and estimate a static fixed-effects IV-GMM labour-demand framework using internal lagged instruments. Because the identification strategy does not rely on an external source of exogenous variation, the estimates are interpreted as conditional associations rather than definitive causal effects. The evidence shows that forward production-based GVC intensity is the most stable positive correlate of FDI-induced jobs, while GVC position is consistently negatively associated with job creation. Backward integration is more nuanced: production-based backward intensity is negative but statistically weaker in the aggregate baseline, and its adverse association is concentrated mainly in low-tech sectors. Formal interaction tests indicate that EU-15/new member-state heterogeneity is most clearly visible for GVC position. Mechanism-oriented evidence suggests that forward GVC participation is associated with larger employment scale per FDI project. Robustness checks using alternative clustering, support diagnostics, official OECD export-based TiVA shares, Poisson IV-GMM and classical PPML level specifications, and a sample excluding 2020 support the main interpretation while underscoring measurement limits.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察全球价值链（GVC）参与度与欧盟27国国家—行业配对层面绿地外商直接投资（FDI）所引致就业创造之间的关联。我们将项目层面的fDi Markets就业数据与基于TiVA的GVC指标相结合，并采用内部滞后工具变量估计静态固定效应IV-GMM劳动需求框架。由于识别策略不依赖外部外生变异来源，估计结果被解释为条件性关联而非确定性因果效应。证据表明，基于前向生产的GVC强度是FDI引致就业最稳定的正相关因素，而GVC位置则始终与就业创造呈负相关。后向参与更为复杂：基于生产的后向强度在总体基准中为负但统计上较弱，其不利关联主要集中于低技术行业。正式交互检验表明，欧盟15国/新成员国异质性在GVC位置上最为明显。机制导向的证据提示，前向GVC参与与每个FDI项目更大的就业规模相关。使用替代聚类、支持诊断、OECD官方基于出口的TiVA份额、Poisson IV-GMM与经典PPML水平设定，以及剔除2020年的样本所进行的稳健性检验支持主要解释，同时凸显了测量局限。
title: From Global Value Chains to Local Jobs: Exploring FDI-induced Job Creation in EU-27
title_zh: 从全球价值链到本地就业：探究外商直接投资对欧盟27国就业创造的效应

abstract: A seller can produce two units of a good. Each unit can be customized into one of two versions, and buyers privately learn their valuations for each version. First I consider the case when the second unit costs more to produce than the first. Under certain distributional conditions the search for the optimal mechanism can be restricted to a class where there is no uncertainty about the number of units the buyer will receive, i.e. the buyer chooses whether to get 0, 1, or 2 units. However, there still may be uncertainty over which version the buyer will get. Buyers whose valuation for their favorite version is high, both in absolute terms and relative to the other version, purchase two units of their favorite version with certainty. Buyers with low values are excluded from purchasing. Buyers with values in the intermediate range typically get a lottery over different versions. I compare the fully optimal mechanism with the mechanism that optimally sells each unit separately and show that the solutions coincide when the fully optimal mechanism is deterministic, but they may differ otherwise. In the case when the cost of the second unit is not higher than the cost of the first the optimal mechanism only contains options with 0 and 2 units. The solution in this case can be shown to be isomorphic to a single unit case.
abstract_zh: 一个卖方可以生产两单位商品。每单位商品可定制为两种版本之一，买方私下获知其对每种版本的估值。首先，我考虑第二单位生产成本高于第一单位的情形。在某些分布条件下，最优机制的搜寻可限制在一类机制中，即买方将获得多少单位不存在不确定性，也就是说，买方选择获得0、1或2单位。然而，买方将获得哪个版本仍可能存在不确定性。对于那些对其最偏好版本估值较高（无论绝对值还是相对于另一版本）的买方，会确定购买两单位其最偏好版本。估值较低的买方被排除在购买之外。估值处于中间范围的买方通常会获得不同版本的抽签。我将完全最优机制与分别最优销售每单位的机制进行比较，并表明当完全最优机制为确定性时两者一致，否则可能不同。在第二单位成本不高于第一单位成本的情形下，最优机制仅包含0单位和2单位的选项。此情形下的解可证明与单单位情形同构。
title: Selling two units of a customizable good
title_zh: 销售两单位可定制商品

abstract: When allocating indivisible goods, the maximum Nash welfare rule is known to be the unique welfarist rule satisfying envy-freeness up to one good. We strengthen this characterization by showing that envy-freeness up to one good can be replaced by substantially weaker fairness requirements: envy-freeness up to 𝑘 goods or proportionality up to 𝑘 goods, for any fixed 𝑘 . Our characterization holds even for profiles with identical goods.
abstract_zh: 在不可分割物品的分配中，最大纳什福利规则被认为是唯一满足至多一件物品无嫉妒性的福利主义规则。我们通过表明至多一件物品无嫉妒性可被显著更弱的公平性要求所替代来强化这一刻画：对于任意固定的k，至多k件物品无嫉妒性或至多k件物品比例性。我们的刻画甚至对具有相同物品的偏好轮廓也成立。
title: Characterizing maximum Nash welfare: Envy-freeness and proportionality
title_zh: 刻画最大纳什福利：无嫉妒与比例性

abstract: Using US Supreme Court’s narrow-decision on Shelby v. Holder as a shock that diluted voting rights of Black Americans in covered counties, we document the relationship between political voice and economic decision-making. We show fewer Black Americans buy homes after their de-facto disenfranchisement, reflected through lower mortgage applications. Among those who apply for mortgages, there is a flight to Black lenders. Leveraging individual-level survey data, we show confidence in government and financial institutions plays a significant role in driving these effects. Our findings demonstrate that the effects of disenfranchisement extend beyond the ballot box to fundamental economic decisions like homeownership.
abstract_zh: 以美国最高法院在谢尔比诉霍尔德案中的窄幅裁决作为冲击事件，该裁决削弱了受覆盖县黑人美国人的投票权，我们记录了政治发声与经济决策之间的关系。我们表明，在事实上的剥夺选举权之后，购房的黑人美国人减少，这通过抵押贷款申请量下降得以体现。在申请抵押贷款的人群中，出现了向黑人贷款机构的转移。利用个体层面的调查数据，我们表明对政府和金融机构的信心在驱动这些效应中发挥重要作用。我们的发现表明，剥夺选举权的影响超越投票箱，延伸至像住房所有权这样的基本经济决策。
title: Political Voice and (Mortgage) Market Participation: Evidence from the dilution of Voting Rights Act
title_zh: 政治声音与（抵押贷款）市场参与：来自《选举权法》稀释的证据

abstract: The hold-up problem plays a central role in organizational and institutional economics. According to standard theory, an investor may have insufficient incentives to invest in a relationship with a trading partner when the investor anticipates that in future negotiations the trading partner might behave opportunistically, so the investor’s costs might not be recouped. In a prominent paper-and-pencil experiment, Ellingsen and Johannesson (2004a) have shown that communication can mitigate the hold-up problem. They allow either the investor or the trading partner to send a single text message to the other player. In order to study the robustness of their findings, we replicate their setup in an online experiment, allowing for a larger number of observations and a different subject pool. Moreover, we extend the original setup by adding a treatment with bilateral communication in order to find out whether or not the possibility of arguing back and forth can further alleviate the hold-up problem.
abstract_zh: 敲竹杠问题在组织与制度经济学中居于核心地位。根据标准理论，当投资者预期在未来谈判中交易伙伴可能采取机会主义行为、以致其成本可能无法收回时，投资者对与交易伙伴建立关系的投资激励可能不足。在一项著名的纸笔实验中，Ellingsen和Johannesson（2004a）表明沟通能够缓解敲竹杠问题。他们允许投资者或交易伙伴中的一方单向向另一方发送一条文本信息。为研究其发现的稳健性，我们在在线实验中复制了他们的实验设置，从而获得更大的观测样本量和不同的被试群体。此外，我们通过增加一个双向沟通的处理组扩展了原始设置，以考察来回争论的可能性是否能够进一步缓解敲竹杠问题。
title: The hold-up problem and communication: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 敲竹杠问题与沟通：实验证据

abstract: This paper investigates how economic catch‐up shapes resource allocation in emerging economies. I develop a model that features firm‐specific technology adoption and costly adjustment of production factors. Rapid technological progress during catch‐up creates strong demand for reallocating resources from slow to fast adopters, amplifying the consequences of adjustment costs. The amplification fades as technological change gradually slows during convergence to a more advanced and efficient steady state. I evaluate the model using Chinese and German enterprise data and find that differences in development stage account for at least 40% of their labour allocative efficiency gap.
abstract_zh: 本文研究经济追赶如何塑造新兴经济体的资源配置。我构建了一个模型，其特征是企业特定技术采用和生产要素的有成本调整。追赶过程中的快速技术进步产生了从慢速采用者向快速采用者重新配置资源的强烈需求，放大了调整成本的后果。随着技术变革在向更先进、更高效的稳态收敛过程中逐渐放缓，这种放大效应也随之减弱。我使用中国和德国的企业数据对模型进行评估，发现发展阶段差异至少可以解释两国劳动配置效率差距的40%。
china_relevance_reason: 论文使用中国企业数据，并将中国作为核心比较对象之一，研究资源错配问题，直接涉及中国。
title: Growing Pains: Inefficient Resource Allocation in Emerging Economies
title_zh: 成长的烦恼：新兴经济体的资源错配

abstract: Many of the world’s renewable resources are in decline. Optimal harvests with smooth recruitment is well studied but in recent years, ecologists have concluded that tipping points in recruitment are common. Recruitment with a tipping point has low-fecundity below the tipping point and high-fecundity above. When the discounted value of high-fecundity is sufficiently high, there is a high-fecundity steady-state. This steady-state is stable but in some cases, small perturbations may result in large, temporary reductions in recruitment and harvests. Below the tipping point, a low-fecundity steady-state need not exist. When a low-fecundity steady-state does exist, there is an endogenous tipping (Skiba) point: below, harvests converge to the low-fecundity steady-state and above, an austere harvest policy transitions the renewable resource to high-fecundity recruitment. If there is hysteresis in recruitment, the high steady-state may not be stable. Moreover, if the high-/low-fecundity differential is large then following a downward perturbation, fecundity optimally remains low.
abstract_zh: 世界上许多可再生资源正在衰退。具有平滑补充机制的最优采伐已有充分研究，但近年来生态学家得出结论，补充过程中的临界点十分常见。存在临界点的补充机制表现为：临界点以下繁殖力低，临界点以上繁殖力高。当高繁殖力的折现值足够高时，存在一个高繁殖力稳态。该稳态是稳定的，但在某些情况下，微小扰动可能导致补充量和采伐量出现大幅暂时性下降。在临界点以下，低繁殖力稳态未必存在。当低繁殖力稳态确实存在时，存在一个内生临界（Skiba）点：在该点以下，采伐量收敛于低繁殖力稳态；在该点以上，一种紧缩性采伐政策将使可再生资源转向高繁殖力补充。若补充过程存在滞后效应，高稳态可能并不稳定。此外，若高/低繁殖力差异较大，则在向下扰动之后，繁殖力最优地保持在低水平。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Renewable Natural Resources, Regime Shift and Hysteresis
title_zh: 可再生自然资源、制度变迁与滞后效应
