title: How Will Hybrid Work Schedules Impact the Demand for Natural Resources? The Case of Urban Water Demand
title_zh: 混合工作安排将如何影响自然资源需求？——以城市用水需求为例

abstract: We investigate assortative matching patterns between dealers and customers in the over-the-counter financial market by employing a recently developed empirical model of strategic network formation. Using UK credit default swap data, we find evidence of assortative matching along two dimensions: observed balance-sheet size for institutions with available asset data, and CDS market activity measured by gross notional exposure. These patterns are consistent with several possible mechanisms, including counterparty-risk management, correlated-risk concerns, search frictions, regulatory constraints, and dealer intermediation capacity. We further examine the determinants of reference-entity-specific networks using various network measures. Our results suggest that trading relationships in CDS transactions involving UK-regulated dealers are concentrated among a relatively small number of active participants, and that reference-entity-level network activity is associated with both hedging and speculative motives. These findings show that OTC market structure reflects both participant characteristics and underlying risks, with implications for market concentration and risk monitoring.
abstract_zh: 我们采用近期开发的策略性网络形成实证模型，研究场外金融市场中交易商与客户之间的同配匹配模式。利用英国信用违约互换数据，我们发现沿两个维度存在同配匹配的证据：对于具有可用资产数据的机构，其观测到的资产负债表规模；以及以总名义敞口衡量的CDS市场活动。这些模式与若干可能机制相一致，包括交易对手风险管理、相关性风险担忧、搜寻摩擦、监管约束以及交易商中介能力。我们进一步使用多种网络指标考察参考实体特定网络的决定因素。我们的结果表明，涉及英国受监管交易商的CDS交易中的交易关系集中于相对少数活跃参与者，且参考实体层面的网络活动与对冲和投机动机均相关。这些发现表明，场外市场结构既反映参与者特征，也反映基础风险，并对市场集中度和风险监测具有启示意义。
title: Assortative matching and network structure in the over-the-counter credit default swap market
title_zh: 场外信用违约互换市场中的同配匹配与网络结构

abstract: Amid the rapid expansion of digital transformation, understanding the economic consequences of corporate digital catering has become increasingly important. Combining large language model-based textual analysis with financial data, this paper constructs a measure of corporate digital catering and examines its association with firm productivity. Using Chinese A-share listed firms, we find a negative association between digital catering and total factor productivity, a pattern that is generally supported by alternative specifications and measurement checks. Further analysis provides supportive evidence consistent with two potential channels: higher operating burdens and tighter financing constraints. The negative association is more pronounced among firms with higher information asymmetry, weaker external governance, and greater digital transformation difficulty, and in regions with weaker market competition, poorer government–market relations, and less developed digital infrastructure. These findings provide new evidence on the authenticity and economic consequences of digital transformation.
abstract_zh: 在数字化转型快速扩张的背景下，理解企业数字迎合的经济后果变得日益重要。本文结合基于大语言模型的文本分析与财务数据，构建了企业数字迎合的度量指标，并考察其与企业生产率之间的关联。基于中国A股上市公司，我们发现数字迎合与全要素生产率之间存在负向关联，这一模式在替代性设定和测量检验中总体得到支持。进一步分析提供了与两个潜在渠道相一致的支持性证据：更高的经营负担和更紧的融资约束。这种负向关联在信息不对称程度更高、外部治理更弱、数字化转型难度更大的企业中，以及在市场竞争更弱、政府—市场关系更差、数字基础设施欠发达的地区中更为显著。这些发现为数字化转型的真实性与经济后果提供了新的证据。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中国A股上市公司，数据与制度背景均明确指向中国，属于直接相关的中国研究。
title: Does talking more but doing less in digital transformation affect total factor productivity? Evidence from large language models
title_zh: 数字化转型中“说多做少”会影响全要素生产率吗？——来自大语言模型的证据

abstract: Expanding access to financial services may not be enough to develop markets in low-income settings: providers also need to be held accountable to consumers. We test this in a field experiment across 195 rural Sierra Leonean communities, upgrading Village Savings and Loan Associations (VSLAs) into mobile money and bank agents, cross-randomized with a monthly consumer feedback mechanism. Upgrading expands access, but feedback drives large operational improvements (+20.5 pp, 85%), particularly in privacy and consumer protection, raising usage and revenues. Upgraded VSLAs also show higher savings digitization and higher incomes, evidence that disciplining agent actions benefits not only consumers but also the principal that finances and stands behind its agent. Interpreted through a framework of delegated intermediation, we show accountability, not infrastructure alone, aligns provider incentives with consumer welfare and is central to designing scalable financial intermediaries.
abstract_zh: 扩大金融服务可及性可能不足以在低收入环境中发展市场：服务提供者还需要对消费者负责。我们在塞拉利昂195个农村社区开展了一项实地实验，将乡村储蓄和贷款协会（VSLA）升级为移动货币和银行代理点，并与每月消费者反馈机制交叉随机化。升级扩大了可及性，但反馈带来了巨大的运营改进（+20.5个百分点，85%），特别是在隐私和消费者保护方面，提高了使用率和收入。升级后的VSLA还表现出更高的储蓄数字化程度和更高的收入，这证明约束代理行为不仅有利于消费者，也有利于为其代理提供融资并为其背书的委托人。通过委托 intermediation 框架进行解释，我们表明问责制——而非仅基础设施——使提供者激励与消费者福利相一致，并且是设计可扩展金融中介的核心。
china_relevance_reason: 研究地点为塞拉利昂农村社区，研究对象、数据与制度背景均非中国，与中国研究无直接关联。
title: Upgrading Financial Markets
title_zh: 升级金融市场

abstract: Foreign aid has become a melting pot of motivations and policies, where differently-motivated actors often converge on recommended policies while the similarly-motivated diverge. Breaking down the “why” and the “how” can illuminate real tensions and reveal false ones. The “why” asks which problems to tackle and who benefits: the recipient, the donor through economic, political, or soft-power returns, or everyone through global public goods. The “how” asks which strategy most cost-effectively addresses a chosen problem. Evidence is central to the “how”: use it where it exists, produce it where it does not. In particular, approaches which improve state capacity to use and generate evidence can satisfy multiple objectives: strengthen recipient countries, benefit donors, and provide a global public good of knowledge. Ultimately, the “how” is not a linear process, but rather an iterative one of learning, adopting, adapting, repeating, and then sharing so others can learn as well.
abstract_zh: 对外援助已成为动机与政策的熔炉，不同动机的行为主体常常在推荐政策上趋同，而动机相似者却出现分歧。拆解“为什么”与“怎么做”可以揭示真实的张力并识别虚假的张力。“为什么”追问要解决哪些问题以及谁受益：受援国、通过经济、政治或软实力回报的援助国，还是通过全球公共品使所有人受益。“怎么做”追问哪种策略能以最具成本效益的方式解决选定的问题。证据对“怎么做”至关重要：在已有证据之处使用证据，在缺乏证据之处生产证据。特别是，提升国家使用和生成证据能力的方法可以满足多重目标：增强受援国、惠及援助国，并提供知识的全球公共品。最终，“怎么做”不是线性过程，而是学习、采纳、调整、重复、再分享以使他人也能学习的迭代过程。
title: The Why and How of Foreign Aid
title_zh: 对外援助的动因与方式

abstract: Analyses of survey data may be confounded if people use response scales differently. We formalize and generalize the theory behind using “calibration questions,” such as vignettes, to correct for scale-use heterogeneity. Finding, in our (N ≈ 10,000) and existing data, that the mapping between respondents’ scales is approximately linear, we develop a simple estimator for scale-use-corrected regressions. We validate it using subjective-scale ratings of height and weight and illustrate it with life satisfaction regressions, where correction leaves the main qualitative findings intact but can substantially change coefficient ratios, for example tripling the estimated cost of unemployment relative to income.
abstract_zh: 如果人们以不同方式使用回答量表，调查数据分析可能会受到混杂。我们形式化并推广了使用“校准问题”（如情境 vignettes）来校正量表使用异质性的理论。在我们的数据（N ≈ 10,000）和现有数据中发现受访者量表之间的映射近似线性后，我们开发了一个用于量表使用校正回归的简单估计量。我们使用身高和体重的主观量表评分对其进行验证，并用生活满意度回归进行说明，其中校正使主要定性发现保持不变，但可能大幅改变系数比率，例如使失业相对于收入的估计成本增至三倍。
title: Correcting for Heterogeneity in the Use of Subjective Scales
title_zh: 校正主观量表使用中的异质性

abstract: China launched a nationwide, rate-based carbon market in 2021. Covering the world’s top CO2 emitter, compliance depends on the intensity of carbon emissions rather than an absolute cap. We draw on the theoretical literature of rate-based systems to provide the first empirical evidence on an early adopter. Using plant-level data from satellite imagery and machine learning methods, we find that high-efficiency power plants increased electricity generation and CO2 emissions by approximately 5% relative to low-efficiency plants. Because its carbon market regulates nearly all coal plants in China, we focus on the differential responses by plant efficiency, finding no evidence of a differential reduction in emission intensity (though these estimates are imprecise). Relative to coal plants in Indonesia and the Philippines, which had no carbon market, China’s high-efficiency plants also increased emissions, while the estimate for its low-efficiency plants is small and insignificant. This pattern of responses suggests that emissions increases of high-efficiency plants exceeded substitution away from low-efficiency plants. Underscoring the production stimulus to more efficient Chinese plants, air quality worsened downwind of high- efficiency plants relative to low-efficiency plants, compromising air quality in relatively clean areas of China. If China's goal is to reduce its carbon emissions, then benchmarks will need to be tightened within the existing system or an alternative system that does not simultaneously incentivize electricity production will need to be adopted.
abstract_zh: 中国于2021年启动了全国性的基于强度的碳市场。该市场覆盖全球最大二氧化碳排放国，其履约取决于碳排放强度而非绝对上限。我们借鉴基于强度体系的理论文献，提供了关于早期采用者的首个实证证据。利用来自卫星影像的工厂级数据和机器学习方法，我们发现高效率电厂相对于低效率电厂将发电量和二氧化碳排放量增加了约5%。由于其碳市场几乎监管中国的所有燃煤电厂，我们聚焦于按电厂效率的差异化反应，未发现排放强度差异化下降的证据（尽管这些估计不精确）。相对于没有碳市场的印度尼西亚和菲律宾燃煤电厂，中国的高效率电厂也增加了排放，而对其低效率电厂的估计较小且不显著。这种反应模式表明，高效率电厂的排放增加超过了从低效率电厂的替代。突显对中国更高效电厂的生产刺激的是，高效率电厂下风向的空气质量相对于低效率电厂恶化，损害了中国相对清洁地区的空气质量。如果中国的目标是减少碳排放，那么需要在现有体系内收紧基准，或采用不会同时激励发电的替代体系。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Too Little too Late? Nationwide Carbon Trading in China
title_zh: 太少太迟？中国全国碳交易

abstract: More than 23 million adults in the United States lack a high school diploma, and most who return to school drop out before graduating. We evaluate a randomized intervention of adult high school students in which coaches delivered text messages that encouraged persistence. We find that assignment to treatment increased graduation by 4.9 percentage points, and the effect of message receipt among compliers is 9.3 percentage points, a 41 percent increase relative to the control mean. The intervention operated on the intensive margin by increasing the number of courses completed, but did not affect student enrollment. The effects of the intervention are concentrated among students assigned to experienced coaches, who customized their messages more extensively. We contextualize the economic impact of the low-cost intervention by comparing labor market earnings of graduates to non-graduates, which implies an earnings benefit of $149 per treated student over four years.
abstract_zh: 美国有超过2300万成年人没有高中文凭，而大多数重返校园者在毕业前辍学。我们评估了一项针对成人高中学生的随机干预，其中教练发送鼓励坚持的短信。我们发现，被分配到处理组使毕业率提高了4.9个百分点，而在遵从者中收到短信的效应为9.3个百分点，相对于控制组均值提高了41%。该干预通过增加完成课程数量在集约边际上发挥作用，但未影响学生入学。干预效应集中在被分配到经验丰富的教练的学生中，这些教练更广泛地定制了短信。我们通过比较毕业生与非毕业生的劳动力市场收入来说明这一低成本干预的经济影响，这意味着每名受处理学生在四年内获得149美元的收益。
title: Staying Connected: Experimental Effects of Coach-Delivered Text Messages in an Adult High School
title_zh: 保持联系：成人高中教练发送短信的实验效应

abstract: Forecasts of the federal budget depend greatly on trends in medical spending. Since 1970, medical spending has nearly tripled as a share of gross domestic product (GDP). However, spending growth has barely exceeded GDP growth since 2010. This difference in growth rates makes forecasting spending difficult. I present scenarios for future spending derived from considering the sources of spending increase, ranging from rapid increases in new, expensive treatments to a reduction in spending due to cost-reducing technology. Even modest increases in spending relative to GDP are likely to overwhelm the federal government’s ability to pay for medical care using current tax instruments.
abstract_zh: 联邦预算预测在很大程度上取决于医疗支出的趋势。自1970年以来，医疗支出占国内生产总值（GDP）的比重几乎增至三倍。然而，自2010年以来，支出增长仅略高于GDP增长。这种增长率差异使支出预测变得困难。我提出了未来支出的情景，这些情景源自对支出增长来源的考虑，范围从新的昂贵治疗方法的快速增长到因降低成本的技术而减少支出。即使支出相对于GDP的温和增长，也可能压倒联邦政府使用当前税收工具支付医疗保健的能力。
title: Will Medical Care Strangle or Save the Federal Budget?
title_zh: 医疗保健会扼杀还是拯救联邦预算？

abstract: A commonly used migration regression relates population changes to local labor demand shocks, often yielding small or statistically insignificant coefficients despite sizable effects on labor market outcomes. We argue that such findings need not imply that mobility is unresponsive to local economic conditions. Rather, conventional migration regressions can be biased, as they do not reflect how workers choose among competing locations. In a parsimonious equilibrium model, local population growth depends on differences between local shocks and those in relevant destinations; when these shocks are correlated, estimated responses are attenuated. Moreover, with industry-level shocks, standard shift-share measures misrepresent locations’ effective exposure, leading to further attenuation. Using simulation experiments based on Brazilian and German administrative data, we show attenuation can exceed 50% and that conventional regression estimates can be highly imprecise. We propose theory-grounded empirical approaches that correct the biases, deliver estimates with a clear structural interpretation, and improve the precision of estimated mobility responses.
abstract_zh: 一种常用的迁移回归将人口变化与地方劳动力需求冲击联系起来，尽管对劳动力市场结果有相当大的影响，却常常产生较小或统计上不显著的系数。我们认为，此类发现并不必然意味着流动性对地方经济状况无反应。相反，传统迁移回归可能存在偏误，因为它们未反映工人如何在竞争性地点之间进行选择。在一个简约的均衡模型中，地方人口增长取决于地方冲击与相关目的地冲击之间的差异；当这些冲击相关时，估计反应会被衰减。此外，对于行业层面冲击，标准移动份额指标误表了地点的有效暴露，导致进一步衰减。使用基于巴西和德国行政数据的模拟实验，我们表明衰减可能超过50%，且传统回归估计可能高度不精确。我们提出有理论依据的实证方法，以校正偏误、提供具有清晰结构解释的估计，并提高估计流动性反应的精确度。
title: Understanding Migration Responses to Local Shocks
title_zh: 理解对地方冲击的迁移反应

abstract: Some firms are more likely than others to invest in workers’ skills. We document this phenomenon and discuss its implications in light of models of firm-sponsored skills training. The data show that better managed firms, even in the same industries and labor markets, are more likely to train, while training clusters around either managerial or frontline worker development. We argue that organizational differences provide incentives for firms to train beyond traditional explanations that focus on labor market frictions. We illustrate how organizational heterogeneity can generate training investments through a knowledge hierarchy framework where top managers with different skills build bespoke organizations tailored to their unique needs. This in turn makes general skill firm-specific, allowing firms to capture returns on training investment.
abstract_zh: 一些企业比其他企业更倾向于投资于员工技能。我们记录了这一现象，并结合企业资助技能培训的模型讨论了其含义。数据显示，即使在相同行业和劳动力市场中，管理更好的企业也更可能提供培训，而培训则围绕管理者或一线员工的发展形成集群。我们认为，组织差异为企业提供了培训激励，这超出了聚焦于劳动力市场摩擦的传统解释。我们通过一个知识层级框架说明组织异质性如何产生培训投资：在该框架中，拥有不同技能的顶层管理者构建量身定制的组织，以满足其独特需求。这反过来使通用技能变得企业特定，从而使企业能够获取培训投资的回报。
title: The Role of Organization in Firm-Sponsored Training
title_zh: 组织在企业资助培训中的作用

abstract: Venture capital specializes in the financing of customer capital intensive firms—firms with higher sales and marketing expense to revenue ratios, a higher wage bill for sales and marketing employees, and a higher tendency to apply for trademarks—and they do so more than other financial intermediaries. Venture capitalists target high customer capital industries with low knowledge capital but avoid high knowledge capital industries that lack customer capital. Firms tilt investment toward customer capital leading up to the initial venture capital investment, after which their scale accelerates rapidly. Venture capitalists focus on financing customer capital because such investments require tolerance for substantial risks of failure in pursuit of extreme upside potential, as characterized by power law returns. This return profile fits customer capital investments more closely than investments in knowledge capital. Venture capitalists that sprinkle small investments across a large number of firms, colloquially referred to as the “spray and pray” strategy, target customer capital industries for investment, whereas venture capitalists that commit larger amounts to a small number of firms target knowledge capital industries. The venture capital focus on customer capital reflects a shift away from its traditional focus on knowledge capital intensive firms over the past 30 years.
abstract_zh: 风险投资专门为客户资本密集型企业融资——这些企业具有更高的销售与营销费用占收入比率、更高的销售与营销员工工资支出，以及更高的商标申请倾向——而且它们比其他金融中介更常这样做。风险投资家瞄准客户资本高但知识资本低的行业，而避开缺乏客户资本的知识资本高行业。企业在首次风险投资进入之前将投资向客户资本倾斜，此后其规模迅速加速扩张。风险投资家专注于为客户资本融资，因为此类投资需要容忍追求极端上行潜力过程中的重大失败风险，其特征是幂律回报。这种回报特征比知识资本投资更贴近客户资本投资。将小额投资分散于大量企业的风险投资家——俗称“撒胡椒面”策略——瞄准客户资本行业进行投资，而将较大金额投入少数企业的风险投资家则瞄准知识资本行业。风险投资对客户资本的关注反映了过去30年其从传统上聚焦知识资本密集型企业发生的转变。
title: Venture Capital and Customer Capital
title_zh: 风险投资与客户资本

abstract: We study how global financial conditions transmit to firms’ investment. We document that increases in risk premia are followed by large investment contractions, particularly among firms with higher default risk. We develop a quantitative heterogeneous-firm open-economy model where firms finance investment with defaultable debt priced by risk-averse global investors. We identify a strong risk channel linking changes in the global price of risk to financing costs through firms’ quantity of risk—the sensitivity of debt repayment to global shocks. This introduces a risk dimension to stabilization policy: smoothing cash flows reduces firms’ quantity of risk and dampens international financial transmission.
abstract_zh: 我们研究全球金融状况如何传导至企业投资。我们记录到，风险溢价上升之后会出现大幅投资收缩，尤其是在违约风险较高的企业中。我们构建了一个量化异质性企业开放经济模型，其中企业用由风险厌恶的全球投资者定价的可违约债务为投资融资。我们识别出一个强风险渠道，将全球风险价格变化通过企业的风险数量——债务偿还对全球冲击的敏感性——与融资成本联系起来。这为稳定政策引入了风险维度：平滑现金流会降低企业的风险数量，并抑制国际金融传导。
title: Firms' Investment and the Real Transmission of the Global Financial Cycle
title_zh: 企业投资与全球金融周期的实体传导

abstract: Do shorter workweeks generate work-sharing and productivity gains, as intended by policymakers? We study France’s pay-preserving reduction in the workweek from 39 to 35 hours, bundled with employer payroll tax cuts. We first exploit the staggered implementation by firm size to identify the impact of the reform package. We then use differential exposure to the hours cut and tax cut to separate their effects. We combine matched employer-employee, balance-sheet, and survey data to study worker, firm, and local labor market effects. The reform package left employment unchanged. This zero masks large offsetting effects: absent the tax cuts, the shorter workweek would have reduced employment by 3.8%. The effects are skill-biased, raising employment among managers and professionals while reducing it among other employees. Finally, shorter hours raised total factor productivity by 2%, limiting the output decline to 1% despite a 6% fall in total hours. Surveys point to work intensification and organizational changes as potential drivers of productivity gains.
abstract_zh: 缩短工作周是否会如政策制定者所期望的那样产生工作分享和生产率收益？我们研究法国在保持工资不变的情况下将工作周从39小时缩短至35小时，并配套雇主工资税减免。我们首先利用按企业规模分阶段实施来识别这一改革组合的影响。然后，我们利用对工时削减和税收减免的差异化暴露来分离其效果。我们结合匹配的雇主—雇员数据、资产负债表数据和调查数据，研究工作、企业和地方劳动力市场层面的影响。该改革组合使就业保持不变。这一零效应掩盖了巨大的抵消性效应：如果没有税收减免，缩短工作周本会使就业减少3.8%。这些效应具有技能偏向性，提高了管理者和专业人员的就业，同时减少了其他雇员的就业。最后，缩短工时使全要素生产率提高2%，尽管总工时下降6%，却将产出下降限制在1%。调查表明，工作强度上升和组织变革可能是生产率收益的潜在驱动因素。
title: The Effects of a Shorter Workweek on Employment, Output, and Productivity
title_zh: 缩短工作周对就业、产出和生产率的影响

abstract: TRIPS (1995) has played a major role in shaping the Indian pharmaceutical industry. Conventional theory suggests that strong intellectual property rights (IPR) frameworks should strengthen innovation incentives. Yet, two decades after TRIPS, growth in India’s novel innovation pipeline has stalled. This chapter challenges the assumption that stronger IPR alone would catalyze discovery-based R&D. We utilize trial phase transition data from the Biomedtracker database, finding that the Indian pipeline faces a bottleneck in transitioning clinical trials specifically from Phase 1 to Phase 2, supported by a null result in transitions from Phase 1 to Phase 3, benchmarked against China and the United Kingdom. We argue that this reflects binding constraints in the Indian ecosystem that are likely orthogonal to IPR, accompanied by a within-firm shift toward non-novel programs. We corroborate these arguments through interviews with Indian pharmaceutical industry experts. Our findings should inform thinking about normative IPR in developing economies.
abstract_zh: TRIPS（1995）在塑造印度制药业方面发挥了重要作用。传统理论认为，强有力的知识产权（IPR）框架应增强创新激励。然而，在TRIPS之后二十年，印度新药创新管线的增长已经停滞。本章挑战了仅靠更强IPR就能催化发现型研发的假设。我们利用Biomedtracker数据库的试验阶段转换数据，发现印度管线在临床试验转换中面临瓶颈，特别是在从1期到2期的转换中，并以从1期到3期转换的零结果作为支持，同时以中国和英国为基准。我们认为，这反映了印度生态系统中可能独立于IPR的约束性限制，并伴随企业向非新颖项目的内部转移。我们通过对印度制药行业专家的访谈佐证了这些论点。我们的发现应为发展中经济体规范性IPR的思考提供参考。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象是印度制药业，中国仅作为基准对照出现，非核心研究对象。
title: The Long March to Innovation: R&D and Competitive Evolution in the Indian Pharmaceutical Industry
title_zh: 通往创新的长征：印度制药业的研发与竞争演化

abstract: School choice can weaken the link between residential neighborhood and educational opportunity only if students can reach the schools available to them. We study school choice in Chicago, where high schoolers can choose among schools throughout the city but generally rely on public transit, making the structure of the transit network a key determinant of opportunity. Using student-level rankings and public transit travel times, we document two systematic patterns: Black students are less likely to rank top-rated schools first and face longer public transit times to such schools. We estimate a discrete choice model to separate the value placed on schools from the costs of reaching them. We find that high schools vary substantially in how they are valued and that there is a high degree of agreement across racial groups in their relative ranking. However, transit times vary significantly across neighborhoods, generating racial differences in demand for top-rated schools. Counterfactually, giving Black students the travel times of white students increases demand for top-rated schools by 23 percentage points. Finally, we identify underserved neighborhoods where public transit access constrains demand and quantify how targeted bus service would increase demand for high-quality schools. Our counterfactuals quantify how transportation expands school access.
abstract_zh: 只有当学生能够到达可用的学校时，学校选择才能削弱居住社区与教育机会之间的联系。我们研究芝加哥的学校选择，当地高中生可以在全市范围内选择学校，但通常依赖公共交通，这使得交通网络结构成为机会的关键决定因素。利用学生层面的排名和公共交通出行时间，我们记录了两个系统性模式：黑人学生将顶尖学校列为第一志愿的可能性较低，并且到此类学校面临的公共交通时间更长。我们估计一个离散选择模型，以分离对学校赋予的价值与到达学校的成本。我们发现，高中在如何被评价方面差异很大，而且不同种族群体在其相对排名上高度一致。然而，各社区的交通时间差异显著，导致对顶尖学校需求的种族差异。反事实地，如果给黑人学生白人学生的出行时间，对顶尖学校的需求将增加23个百分点。最后，我们识别出公共交通接入制约需求的服务不足社区，并量化定向公交服务将如何增加对高质量学校的需求。我们的反事实量化了交通如何扩大学校获取。
title: Transportation as a Barrier to Education Access: Evidence from Chicago Public Schools
title_zh: 交通作为教育获取的障碍：来自芝加哥公立学校的证据

abstract: We use a dynamic factor time series model to estimate the national mortality impact of the Great Recession. In aggregate, the Great Recession reduced the average annual, age-adjusted mortality rate by about 2 percent, with effects persisting for at least a decade. In a calibrated model of the welfare effects of the estimated impacts of the Great Recession on consumption and mortality, we find that the welfare gain from the estimated mortality decline is quantitatively significant relative to the welfare loss from the estimated consumption decline. The estimated mortality decline is also quantitatively close to prior mortality estimates using cross-sectional variation in the severity of the Great Recession, implying limited general equilibrium effects of the Great Recession on mortality. More broadly, our findings suggest that prior evidence from local labor markets that recessions are good for health can be extrapolated to the likely mortality consequences of nationwide recessions.
abstract_zh: 我们使用动态因子时间序列模型来估计大衰退对全国死亡率的影响。总体而言，大衰退使年均年龄调整死亡率下降约2%，且影响持续至少十年。在一个校准的福利效应模型中，该模型纳入估计的大衰退对消费和死亡率的影响，我们发现估计的死亡率下降所带来的福利收益相对于估计的消费下降所带来的福利损失在数量上是显著的。估计的死亡率下降在数量上也接近先前使用大衰退严重程度横截面变异得到的死亡率估计，这意味着大衰退对死亡率的总体均衡效应有限。更广泛地说，我们的发现表明，先前来自地方劳动力市场的证据——即衰退对健康有益——可以外推到全国性衰退可能的死亡率后果。
title: The Impact of the Great Recession on Mortality: A Dynamic Factor Analysis
title_zh: 大衰退对死亡率的影响：动态因子分析

abstract: How leaders allocate their limited time and attention is an important question in economics. This paper constructs and analyzes a novel data set covering the daily calendars of three Federal Reserve Chairs, Ben Bernanke, Janet Yellen, and Jerome Powell, containing more than 20,000 calendar entries. We document several patterns. First, all Fed Chairs spend more than 30% of their documented meetings with Fed staff, highlighting the crucial role of economists in the Fed's decision process. Second, interactions with the media became more frequent during Bernanke's tenure and remained important until the end of Powell's tenure. Third, Powell held significantly more meetings with lawmakers than both Yellen and Bernanke, reflecting an increasing need for the Fed to engage with political actors. Beyond these trend patterns, we examine the time allocation of Fed Chairs at business cycle frequencies and show how different activities respond to shifts in the macroeconomic environment. Finally, we place our findings in historical context using the available calendars of earlier Fed Chairs, including Alan Greenspan.
abstract_zh: 领导者如何分配有限的时间和注意力是经济学中的一个重要问题。本文构建并分析了一个新颖的数据集，涵盖三位美联储主席本·伯南克、珍妮特·耶伦和杰罗姆·鲍威尔的每日日历，包含超过20,000条日历条目。我们记录了若干模式。第一，所有美联储主席将超过30%的有记录会议用于与美联储工作人员会面，凸显了经济学家在美联储决策过程中的关键作用。第二，与媒体的互动在伯南克任期内变得更加频繁，并一直重要到鲍威尔任期结束。第三，鲍威尔与立法者的会面显著多于耶伦和伯南克，反映出美联储与政治行为者接触的需求日益增加。除了这些趋势模式外，我们还考察了美联储主席在商业周期频率上的时间分配，并展示了不同活动如何响应宏观经济环境的变化。最后，我们利用包括艾伦·格林斯潘在内的早期美联储主席的可用日历，将我们的发现置于历史背景中。
title: Inside Central Bankers’ Calendars: How Do Fed Chairs Allocate Their Time?
title_zh: 央行行长的日历内幕：美联储主席如何分配时间？

abstract: Credit constraints and other demand distortions are pervasive in lower-income contexts. A model of clean technology adoption shows that demand distortions can increase the welfare gains from green subsidies. This arises through two channels: shifting the marginal adopter toward higher private and social benefits, and increasing demand elasticity. We test this by cross-randomizing purchase price subsidies, usage subsidies, and access to an interest-free loan for a US$84 induction stove among 2,134 charcoal users in Kenya. Usage subsidies of 75% have a precise zero effect on adoption and usage. Purchase price subsidies, however, generate large welfare gains. Credit constraints raise the subsidy’s efficacy by 35%–73%, up to US$10–US$12 in observable welfare gain per subsidy dollar. This demand distortion also lowers the subsidy cost of abatement by 41%, to US$12 per tCO2e. This operates through the two channels identified in the theory: credit constraints raise the marginal adopter’s positive externality by 19% and fuel savings by 30%, and lower the subsidy cost per marginal adoption by 29%. In a counterfactual without demand distortions, the abatement cost rises to US$137 per tCO2e. Contexts with large demand distortions could offer many cost-effective opportunities for climate change mitigation financing.
abstract_zh: 信贷约束和其他需求扭曲在低收入环境中普遍存在。一个清洁技术采用模型表明，需求扭曲可以增加绿色补贴的福利收益。这通过两个渠道产生：将边际采用者转向更高的私人和社会收益，以及增加需求弹性。我们通过在肯尼亚2,134名木炭使用者中交叉随机化购买价格补贴、使用补贴和获得无息贷款（用于一台84美元的电磁炉）来检验这一点。75%的使用补贴对采用和使用具有精确的零效应。然而，购买价格补贴产生了巨大的福利收益。信贷约束将补贴的有效性提高了35%–73%，每1美元补贴带来高达10–12美元的可观察福利收益。这种需求扭曲还将减排的补贴成本降低了41%，降至每吨二氧化碳当量12美元。这通过理论中确定的两个渠道发挥作用：信贷约束将边际采用者的正外部性提高了19%，燃料节省提高了30%，并将每边际采用的补贴成本降低了29%。在没有需求扭曲的反事实中，减排成本上升至每吨二氧化碳当量137美元。具有巨大需求扭曲的环境可能为气候变化减缓融资提供许多成本有效的机会。
title: Green Subsidies with Demand Distortions
title_zh: 存在需求扭曲的绿色补贴

abstract: The return covariance matrix is widely assumed to have an eigenvalue cliff: a few large eigenvalues, then a bounded bulk, as in the approximate factor structure of Chamberlain and Rothschild (1983). This premise underlies factor tests, principal-component methods, and large-covariance estimation. These methods estimate moments from returns pooled across states, so they necessarily view a conditional world unconditionally. We show that, generically, this view removes the cliff: a conditional model with a few factors is, unconditionally, an infinite-factor model in which infinitely many eigenvalues diverge. This holds for the characteristic-managed portfolios that machine-learning methods trade, and for individual stocks whose loadings differ persistently across firms. Yet as long as conditional expected returns admit no asymptotic arbitrage, the maximal Sharpe ratio stays finite. For generic expected returns, infinitely many components are priced, so no finite set of principal components spans expected returns. Reducing returns to a few principal components therefore discards priced risk.
abstract_zh: 收益率协方差矩阵被广泛假设具有特征值悬崖：少数大特征值，然后是有界的主体，如Chamberlain和Rothschild（1983）的近似因子结构。这一前提是因子检验、主成分方法和大协方差估计的基础。这些方法从跨状态合并的收益率中估计矩，因此它们必然以无条件视角看待条件世界。我们表明，一般而言，这种视角消除了悬崖：一个具有少数因子的条件模型，在无条件意义下是一个无限因子模型，其中无限多个特征值发散。这适用于机器学习方法交易的特征管理组合，以及载荷在不同公司间持续不同的个股。然而，只要条件预期收益率不存在渐近套利，最大夏普比率就保持有限。对于一般预期收益率，无限多个成分被定价，因此没有有限的主成分集合能够张成预期收益率。因此，将收益率缩减为少数主成分会丢弃被定价的风险。
title: Infinite Factor Structure in Conditional Asset Pricing
title_zh: 条件资产定价中的无限因子结构

abstract: We characterize equilibria in a canonical class of economies with endogenous production networks, showing that log-prices equal a min-max over networks of a primitive affine function of log-productivities. This formula captures how resilience and fragility interact: the "min" reflects resilience from substituting suppliers, while the "max" reflects fragility from complementarity-induced rigidity. Applying these results, we generalize Hulten's theorem, finding that local Domar weights are generally insufficient to describe propagation of even small shocks. Moreover, we characterize how microeconomic volatility affects GDP, finding that smooth changes in Domar weights overstate its adverse effects by omitting option value from switching suppliers.
abstract_zh: 我们刻画了一类具有内生生产网络的典型经济中的均衡，表明对数价格等于网络上的极小极大值，该极小极大值是对数生产率的原始仿射函数。这一公式捕捉了韧性与脆弱性如何相互作用：“极小”反映了替代供应商带来的韧性，而“极大”反映了互补性引起的刚性所带来的脆弱性。应用这些结果，我们推广了Hulten定理，发现局部Domar权重通常不足以描述即使是小冲击的传播。此外，我们刻画了微观经济波动如何影响GDP，发现Domar权重的平滑变化通过忽略转换供应商的期权价值而高估了其不利影响。
title: The Robust Properties of Economies with Endogenous Production Networks
title_zh: 内生生产网络经济的稳健性质

abstract: This paper investigates how the expansion of social insurance affects households’ accumulation of debt. Insurance can reduce reliance on debt by lessening the financial impact of adverse events such as illness and job loss. But it can also weaken the motive to self-insure through savings, and households’ improved financial resilience can increase access to credit. Using data on 10 million people and a quasi-experimental research design, we estimate the causal effect of expanded insurance on household debt, exploiting ZIP-level heterogeneity in exposure to the staggered expansions of one of the largest US social insurance programs: Medicaid. We find that a 1 percentage point increase in a ZIP code’s Medicaid-eligible population increases credit card borrowing by 0.38%. Decomposing this effect in a model of household borrowing, we show that increased credit supply in response to households’ improved financial resilience drives the rise in borrowing and contributes 30% of the net welfare gains of expanding Medicaid.
abstract_zh: 本文研究社会保险的扩张如何影响家庭债务的积累。保险可以通过减轻疾病和失业等不利事件的财务冲击来减少对债务的依赖。但它也可能削弱通过储蓄进行自我保险的动机，而家庭财务韧性的改善可以增加信贷可得性。我们使用1000万人的数据和准实验研究设计，利用美国最大的社会保险项目之一——医疗补助计划（Medicaid）交错扩张在邮政编码层面的暴露异质性，估计保险扩张对家庭债务的因果效应。我们发现，一个邮政编码中符合医疗补助资格的人口增加1个百分点，信用卡借款增加0.38%。在家庭借款模型中分解这一效应，我们表明，家庭财务韧性改善带来的信贷供给增加推动了借款上升，并贡献了扩大医疗补助净福利收益的30%。
title: The Impact of Social Insurance on Household Debt
title_zh: 社会保险对家庭债务的影响

abstract: Market power may arise not only from firms, but also from individual salespeople who can exploit informational advantages over consumers. We explore this phenomenon in the mortgage market by examining a Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac fee waiver targeted at lower-income first-time homebuyers. We estimate that mortgage intermediaries capture over 60% of $1.5 billion in total fee waivers during 2023–2024, rather than fully passing these savings through to borrowers. Pass-through varies substantially across loan officers: those with a track record of originating expensive mortgages (independent of lender pricing) pass through less than 20% of the waiver. Our evidence suggests that loan officers retain incentives to steer borrowers into higher-rate mortgages, despite post-crisis regulations designed to limit such practices.
abstract_zh: 市场势力不仅可能来自企业，也可能来自能够利用对消费者信息优势的个体销售人员。我们通过考察针对低收入首次购房者的房利美/房地美费用豁免，在抵押贷款市场中探讨这一现象。我们估计，在2023—2024年期间，抵押贷款中介获取了15亿美元总费用豁免中的超过60%，而非将这些节省完全转嫁给借款人。转嫁率在贷款专员之间差异很大：那些有发放高成本抵押贷款记录（与贷款机构定价无关）的贷款专员转嫁的豁免不足20%。我们的证据表明，尽管危机后监管旨在限制此类做法，贷款专员仍保留将借款人引导至更高利率抵押贷款的激励。
title: Pricing Power in the Mortgage Market: Evidence from GSE Fee Waivers
title_zh: 抵押贷款市场的定价能力：来自政府支持企业费用豁免的证据

abstract: Gains from trade are typically calculated using a constant trade elasticity estimated from substitution across foreign countries. For general homothetic preferences, we show how to calculate these gains from the initial domestic expenditure share and the home-foreign elasticity function along a price path to autarky. While this function generally depends on the specific price path, under weak separability it does not. We provide conditions for its nonparametric identification and estimate sector-level elasticity functions using tariff changes implied by trade agreements. Across WIOD and OECD ICIO data, estimated home-foreign elasticities generally rise with domestic expenditure shares. Using estimated elasticity functions in a multi-sector model with intermediate inputs, the median gain across the WIOD countries is 19.37 log points, compared with 24.43 when each country-sector elasticity is held fixed at its initial value.
abstract_zh: 贸易收益通常使用从外国国家间替代估计的恒定贸易弹性来计算。对于一般位似偏好，我们展示如何从初始国内支出份额以及沿价格路径至自给自足的本国—外国弹性函数来计算这些收益。虽然该函数通常取决于具体价格路径，但在弱可分性下则不然。我们提供其非参数识别的条件，并利用贸易协定所隐含的关税变化估计部门层面的弹性函数。在WIOD和OECD ICIO数据中，估计的本国—外国弹性通常随国内支出份额上升。在包含中间投入的多部门模型中使用估计的弹性函数，WIOD国家的收益中位数为19.37个对数点，而将每个国家—部门弹性固定在其初始值时则为24.43。
china_relevance_reason: 研究主题为贸易收益与弹性函数的一般理论及跨国数据（WIOD/OECD），未以中国为研究对象或数据背景。
title: Home-Foreign Elasticity Functions and the Gains from Trade
title_zh: 本国—外国弹性函数与贸易收益

abstract: We study equilibrium market structure in a model of credit-market competition with correlated or uncorrelated screening errors and endogenous screening technologies. A pool externality arises because rejected borrowers reapply elsewhere, so lenders’ screening and pricing choices affect competitors’ applicant pools. With independent errors, a single market segment emerges, with rates rising smoothly as lenders who choose better technologies lend to more adversely selected borrowers. With correlated screening errors, potentially stemming from similar AI systems and overlapping financial-sector data, ex-ante identical lenders instead specialize across qualitatively distinct segments, generating a hockey-stick interest-rate schedule: segments with uniform rates but heterogeneous borrower quality coexist with segments featuring uniform quality but dispersed rates, echoing traditional banking, fintech, and high-rate indiscriminate lending. We show how technological and regulatory changes affecting screening costs, including frontier AI innovation and various forms of open banking, unevenly affect financial access and can either benefit or harm financially excluded borrowers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个信贷市场竞争模型的均衡市场结构，该模型具有相关或不相关的筛选误差以及内生筛选技术。由于被拒绝的借款人会到别处重新申请，因此产生池外部性，贷款机构的筛选和定价选择会影响竞争对手的申请池。在独立误差下，出现单一市场细分，利率随着选择更好技术的贷款机构向更多逆向选择的借款人放贷而平滑上升。在相关筛选误差下（可能源于相似的人工智能系统和重叠的金融部门数据），事前相同的贷款机构反而在性质不同的细分市场之间专业化，产生曲棍球杆式利率曲线：统一利率但借款人质量异质的细分市场与质量统一但利率分散的细分市场并存，呼应传统银行、金融科技和高利率无差别放贷。我们展示影响筛选成本的技术和监管变化（包括前沿人工智能创新和各种形式的开放银行）如何不均衡地影响金融可得性，并可能使被金融排斥的借款人受益或受损。
title: Credit Markets with New Screening Technologies
title_zh: 具有新筛选技术的信贷市场

abstract: We study the optimality of human groundwater extraction from many of the world's 3,400 aquifers, where institutional or market failures may produce non-optimal extraction decisions. We use remote sensing and economic data to estimate a dynamic model of water extraction for each aquifer, recover the discount factor that rationalizes observed groundwater extraction, and compare it against Ramsey and market benchmarks. Three- to four-fifths of aquifers are extracted more rapidly than is optimal, decreasing aquifer present value by several percent, and creating trillions of dollars in present value welfare losses. Policies that guarantee users constant water quantities indefinitely, through subsidies or prior appropriation, or policy rules that fully discount future extraction, generate larger welfare costs. A sustainable extraction path that maintains current fill forever generates meaningfully lower welfare than the optimal extraction path, because most aquifer stocks are already inefficiently low.
abstract_zh: 我们研究人类从全球3,400个含水层中的许多含水层抽取地下水的最优性，其中制度或市场失灵可能产生非最优抽取决策。我们使用遥感和经济数据为每个含水层估计地下水抽取的动态模型，恢复使观测到的地下水抽取合理化的贴现因子，并将其与拉姆齐和市场基准进行比较。五分之三至五分之四的含水层抽取速度快于最优水平，使含水层现值下降几个百分点，并造成数万亿美元的现值福利损失。通过补贴或先占权保证用户无限期获得恒定水量的政策，或对未来抽取完全贴现的政策规则，会产生更大的福利成本。永远维持当前蓄水量的可持续抽取路径所产生的福利显著低于最优抽取路径，因为大多数含水层储量已经低至无效率水平。
title: Are We Consuming Too Much Groundwater?
title_zh: 我们是否消耗了过多地下水？

abstract: States that delegate governance to local officials face a trade-off between the benefits of local knowledge and the costs of biased administrators. Can imposing federal standards discipline bias and improve uniformity? We study this question by examining the introduction of federal standards to apply for citizenship under the 1906 Naturalization Act. Using newly-digitized census records covering over five million immigrants and a 30-year period, we show that standardizing adjudication of citizenship applications resulted in rapid convergence of naturalization practices across cities. While naturalizations were around 30% higher in election years pre-reform, this electoral cycle disappeared after the introduction of federal standards. Exploiting the staggered adoption of municipal civil service reforms aimed at removing patronage during the Progressive Era, we find that the reduction in political cycles was strongest in unreformed cities. Finally, the contraction in election year naturalizations changed the composition of new citizens. Affected cohorts earned 7% more, were more likely to enter citizenship-restricted occupations, and gave children more Americanized names. Our results thus show that standardizing administrative procedures can discipline politically-biased policy implementation.
abstract_zh: 将治理委托给地方官员的州面临地方知识收益与有偏管理者成本之间的权衡。施加联邦标准能否约束偏见并提高统一性？我们通过考察1906年《归化法》下申请公民身份的联邦标准的引入来研究这一问题。使用覆盖超过500万移民和30年期间的新数字化人口普查记录，我们表明，公民身份申请裁决的标准化导致各城市归化实践迅速趋同。改革前选举年的归化入籍率约高出30%，但在引入联邦标准后这一选举周期消失了。利用进步时代旨在消除恩庇制的市政公务员改革的分批采纳，我们发现政治周期的减少在未改革城市中最强。最后，选举年归化入籍的收缩改变了新公民的构成。受影响 cohort 的收入高出7%，更可能进入限制公民身份的职业，并给孩子起更美国化的名字。因此，我们的结果表明，标准化行政程序可以约束政治偏倚的政策执行。
title: From Politics to Process: Evidence from Progressive Era Naturalizations
title_zh: 从政治到程序：来自进步时代归化入籍的证据

abstract: We propose a general equilibrium model in which U.S. monetary policy affects global risk premia by revaluing the wealth of currency-mismatched arbitrageurs. Assuming their portfolios are mean-variance efficient, arbitrageurs must be short the dollar. A U.S. tightening thus erodes arbitrageurs' net worth and raises the global price of risk. We discipline this mechanism to rationalize the effects of U.S. monetary policy on international asset prices, and we quantify the associated macroeconomic spillovers and role of policy responses abroad. In a potential future with higher dollar interest rates, arbitrageurs' dollar funding and U.S. monetary policy spillovers are dampened.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个一般均衡模型，其中美国货币政策通过重估存在货币错配的套利者的财富来影响全球风险溢价。假设其投资组合是均值-方差有效的，套利者必须做空美元。因此，美国收紧政策会侵蚀套利者的净值并提高全球风险价格。我们约束这一机制以合理化美国货币政策对国际资产价格的影响，并量化相关的宏观经济学溢出效应和国外政策应对的作用。在一个美元利率更高的潜在未来中，套利者的美元融资和美国货币政策溢出效应受到抑制。
title: A Model of U.S. Monetary Policy and the Global Financial Cycle
title_zh: 美国货币政策与全球金融周期的模型

abstract: Immigration affects natives through both labor markets and public budgets, yet these channels are usually studied separately. We combine them in a general-equilibrium model with search-and-matching frictions, skill-specific progressive labor taxes, capital taxation and public goods, calibrated to 17 OECD countries over 2015-2019. The welfare effect on natives of a one-percentage-point increase in immigrant inflows varies in sign and size across countries, hinging on immigrants' skill mix, immigrant-native wage gaps, resident unemployment, and tax progressivity. For inflows matching the skill composition of 2019-2024 arrivals, native welfare rises in 14 of 17 economies, and in most cases both skill groups gain, through different channels. Lower-skilled natives gain mainly from higher pre-tax earnings, driven by job creation and complementarity with skilled immigrants; higher-skilled natives gain mainly from lower labor-tax burdens. Evaluating immigration policy thus requires modeling labor-market and fiscal channels jointly: either channel alone gives an incomplete picture of who gains and why.
abstract_zh: 移民通过劳动力市场和公共预算两条渠道影响本地人，但这两条渠道通常被分开研究。我们将它们结合在一个带有搜寻与匹配摩擦、技能特定累进劳动税、资本税和公共品的一般均衡模型中，并对2015-2019年17个OECD国家进行校准。移民流入增加一个百分点对本地人福利的影响在符号和大小上因国家而异，取决于移民的技能构成、移民-本地人工资差距、居民失业率和税收累进性。对于与2019-2024年到达者技能构成相匹配的流入，17个经济体中有14个本地人福利上升，且在大多数情况下两个技能群体都通过不同渠道获益。低技能本地人主要从更高的税前收入中获益，这由就业创造和与高技能移民的互补性驱动；高技能本地人主要从更低的劳动税负担中获益。因此，评估移民政策需要联合建模劳动力市场和财政渠道：单独任一渠道都无法完整描绘谁获益以及为何获益。
title: Modeling and Evaluating the Labor Market and Fiscal Effects of Immigration
title_zh: 移民的劳动力市场与财政效应的建模与评估

abstract: We study the role of foreign ideas in U.S. innovation by constructing a directed “genealogy” of technologies from the full text of 13 million patents filed between 1887 and 2024. By tracing which earlier technologies appear in the founding patents of new ones, we recover a large-scale input–output network of technological recombination that identifies the foreign technologies that serve as inputs into innovation in the United States. We report four main findings. First, foreign ideas are pervasive: 54% of U.S. technologies build on at least one foreign input, and the most fertile U.S. technologies rely on foreign inputs most heavily. Second, foreign ideas have large causal effects on U.S. innovation. Using the historical settlement of migrants as a source of exogenous variation in local ancestry, we show that U.S. counties more exposed to knowledge from a given foreign country absorb substantially more technologies from that country and, in turn, invent significantly more U.S. technologies building on them. Third, foreign ideas shape not only the level but also the direction of technical change: U.S. counties are far more likely to pioneer the specific technologies whose foreign inputs are already in their local idea stock, and the changing origins of foreign ideas accompany the shift of American innovation from its historical heartland toward the coasts. Fourth, these effects leave a lasting imprint on local labor markets: decades later, counties that absorbed more of an origin’s ideas host more jobs working with those ideas, and even more work with the U.S. technologies descended from them.
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建1887年至2024年间提交的1300万项专利全文的技术有向“谱系”，研究外国思想在美国创新中的作用。通过追溯哪些早期技术出现在新技术的奠基专利中，我们恢复了一个大规模的技术重组投入-产出网络，识别出作为美国创新投入的外国技术。我们报告四个主要发现。第一，外国思想无处不在：54%的美国技术建立在至少一项外国投入之上，而最具生产力的美国技术最严重依赖外国投入。第二，外国思想对美国创新具有巨大的因果效应。利用移民的历史定居作为本地祖先的外生变异来源，我们表明，对某一特定外国国家知识暴露更多的美国县吸收来自该国的技术显著更多，进而发明显著更多建立在其上的美国技术。第三，外国思想不仅塑造技术变化的水平，还塑造其方向：美国县更可能开创那些外国投入已存在于其本地思想存量中的特定技术，而外国思想来源的变化伴随着美国创新从其历史核心地带向沿海地区的转移。第四，这些效应对本地劳动力市场留下持久印记：数十年后，吸收某一来源思想更多的县拥有更多使用这些思想的工作岗位，甚至有更多工作使用源自它们的美国技术。
title: Foreign Giants' Broad Shoulders: The Causal Effect of Foreign Ideas on U.S. Innovation
title_zh: 外国巨人的宽阔肩膀：外国思想对美国创新的因果效应

abstract: This paper examines the revenue and migration impact of the 2026 California Billionaire Tax Act, a one-time 5 percent tax on the worldwide net worth of individuals exceeding $1 billion. Using data from the Forbes Billionaire List, news reports detailing the residential real estate holdings of California billionaires, and public announcements of billionaire departures from the state, we estimate the behavioral response and associated revenue loss to this new tax using several different methodologies. Even before accounting for reductions in other tax bases such as the income tax, we estimate that the Act will collect approximately $30 billion (range $28 to 36 billion), less than a third of the $100 billion projected by Galle et al. (2025). This range accounts for the publicly confirmed taxpayer migration that has already eliminated nearly 30 percent of the Act's wealth tax base, applies a litigation-survival discount to the remaining base, and is validated by the wealth tax base elasticity literature. We estimate that California's billionaires contribute $3.3–5.8 billion annually in state income taxes. The present value of permanently lost income tax collections from departures more than offsets the one-time wealth tax revenue, yielding a net present value of negative $38.9 billion. Across 100,000 simulated revenue and discount rate combinations, 85 percent of plausible outcomes produce a negative net present value of state revenues.
abstract_zh: 本文考察2026年加州亿万富翁税法案的收入和迁移影响，该法案对个人全球净资产超过10亿美元者一次性征收5%的税。利用福布斯亿万富翁榜单数据、详述加州亿万富翁住宅房地产持有情况的新闻报道，以及亿万富翁离开该州的公开公告，我们使用多种不同方法估计这一新税的行为反应及相关收入损失。即使在考虑所得税等其他税基的减少之前，我们估计该法案将征收约300亿美元（范围280亿至360亿美元），不到Galle等（2025）预测的1000亿美元的三分之一。该范围考虑了已公开确认的纳税人迁移，这已消除该法案财富税基的近30%，对剩余税基适用诉讼存活折扣，并得到财富税基弹性文献的验证。我们估计加州亿万富翁每年贡献33亿至58亿美元的州所得税。因离开而永久损失的所得税征收现值超过一次性财富税收入，产生负389亿美元的净现值。在100,000次模拟的收入和贴现率组合中，85%的合理结果产生州收入的负净现值。
title: The Net Present Value of the California Billionaire Tax Act
title_zh: 加州亿万富翁税法案的净现值

abstract: Export controls restrict trade to limit adversaries’ access to goods that contribute to military capability, but their effectiveness depends on how trade and production adjust across countries. We combine new data on U.S. export control classifications and licensing outcomes with a quantitative general equilibrium model featuring dual-use production, input-output linkages, and separate civilian and military final expenditure. We estimate large export and entry frictions from these controls. These effects are substantially smaller for U.S. exports to members of multilateral export control regimes (MECRs): the differential is equivalent to an export cost of 15 to 29 log points. Relative to a counterfactual without differential controls on adversaries, multilateral controls reduce their imports of controlled products far more than unilateral U.S. controls. Only 7% of the reduction in controlled exports under the multilateral regime is replaced by other countries, compared with 28% under unilateral U.S. policy. Multilateral controls reduce adversaries’ real military expenditure by increasing their military price index. The security impact, measured as U.S. real military expenditure relative to adversaries, rises by about 1 log point under multilateral controls but only 0.14 log points under unilateral controls, with both imposing a similar civilian real cost. Even a U.S. embargo fails to reproduce the multilateral security outcome.
abstract_zh: 出口管制限制贸易以限制对手获取有助于军事能力的商品，但其有效性取决于贸易和生产如何在各国之间调整。我们将美国出口管制分类和许可结果的新数据与一个量化一般均衡模型相结合，该模型具有两用生产、投入-产出联系以及单独的民用和军用最终支出。我们从这些管制中估计出巨大的出口和进入摩擦。这些效应对美国向多边出口管制机制（MECR）成员的出口要小得多：差异相当于15至29个对数点的出口成本。相对于不对对手实施差别管制的反事实，多边管制比美国单边管制更多地减少对手对受管制产品的进口。在多边机制下受管制出口减少中只有7%被其他国家替代，而在美国单边政策下为28%。多边管制通过提高对手的军事价格指数来减少其实际军事支出。以美国实际军事支出相对于对手衡量，安全影响在多边管制下上升约1个对数点，但在单边管制下仅上升0.14个对数点，而两者施加相似的民用实际成本。即使美国禁运也无法复制多边安全结果。
china_relevance_reason: 研究聚焦美国出口管制与多边机制，数据与政策背景均为美国，未涉及中国。
title: Export Controls and the Economics of National Security
title_zh: 出口管制与国家安全经济学

abstract: Disabled and older adults have lower employment rates than other workers. Policymakers increasingly point to remote work as a way to keep these groups attached to the labour market. This column uses the pandemic-driven rise in working from home in the UK as a quasi-experiment to explore remote work’s impacts on employment and other outcomes such as commute times, hours worked, and wages. A one percentage point increase in working from home raises full-time employment of people with a physical disability by about 0.9%, close to estimates for the US, and raises full-time employment of workers aged 50 to 64 by about 0.4%.
abstract_zh: 残疾人和老年人的就业率低于其他劳动者。政策制定者日益强调远程办公是使这些群体保持与劳动力市场联系的一种方式。本专栏利用英国疫情期间居家办公的增加作为准实验，探讨远程办公对就业以及通勤时间、工作时长和工资等其他结果的影响。居家办公比例每增加一个百分点，身体残疾者的全职就业率约提高0.9%，接近对美国的估计，并使50至64岁劳动者的全职就业率约提高0.4%。
authors: Ian Burn, Melissa Gentry, Joanna Lahey
title: Here, there, and everywhere: Remote work and the employment of disabled and older workers in the UK
title_zh: 这里、那里和到处：远程工作与英国残疾工人和老年工人的就业

abstract: When nominal interest rates hit the effective lower bound, central banks turned to unconventional measures, with forward guidance emerging as a cornerstone of monetary policy. Drawing on economic literature and data on interest rate forecasts, this column assesses the impact of forward guidance on interest rate forecasts. Crucially, during forward guidance episodes public information proves less accurate than private information. Despite this inaccuracy, forecasters over-rely on public information.
abstract_zh: 当名义利率触及有效下限时，中央银行转向非常规措施，其中前瞻性指引成为货币政策的基石。本文依据经济学文献及利率预测数据，评估前瞻性指引对利率预测的影响。关键在于，在前瞻性指引实施期间，公共信息被证明不如私人信息准确。尽管存在这种不准确性，预测者仍过度依赖公共信息。
title: Forward guidance and the limits of public information
title_zh: 前瞻性指引与公共信息的局限

abstract: Does extending full health coverage to an excluded group induce health externalities for the population already insured? In 2022 Colombia expanded health services from emergency only to full access to approximately two million Venezuelan migrants. Comparing municipalities more and less exposed to program take-up before and after its onset, this paper finds that the program reduced mortality rates for Colombians, saving one Colombian life for each 300 migrants covered. The effects are explained by a more efficient use of the health services by beneficiaries and regular and timely payments for the newly insured patients. The Colombian deaths saved are those that timely health treatment prevents. The net fiscal cost of the program is USD 93,000 per Colombian life saved, well below the value of a statistical life.
abstract_zh: 将全额健康保险扩展至被排除群体，是否会对已参保人群产生健康外部性？2022年，哥伦比亚将约两百万委内瑞拉移民的医疗服务从仅限急诊扩展至全面可及。本文比较该项目启动前后参与率较高与较低的城市，发现该项目降低了哥伦比亚人的死亡率，每覆盖300名移民即挽救一名哥伦比亚人的生命。其效应可由受益人对医疗服务更有效的利用以及为新参保患者定期、及时支付费用来解释。被挽救的哥伦比亚人死亡是及时治疗本可避免的死亡。该项目的净财政成本为每挽救一名哥伦比亚人生命93,000美元，远低于统计生命价值。
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: Public Externalities of Universal Health Care Access
title_zh: 全民医疗保健可及性的公共外部性

abstract: We study efficient and buyer-surplus maximizing information policies in a bilateral trade setting where the buyer is initially privately imperfectly informed about his willingness to pay. We identify a canonical class of demand functions that can be implemented by information disclosures that are targeted based on the buyer’s initial private information. As an application we show that providing more information to the buyer can lead to higher market prices and a lower trade probability without affecting the buyer or seller surplus.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在双边贸易环境中，买方最初对其支付意愿拥有私人但不完全信息时的有效且最大化买方剩余的信息政策。我们识别出一类典型的需求函数，这些函数可通过基于买方初始私人信息定向披露的信息来实现。作为一个应用，我们表明，向买方提供更多信息可能导致更高的市场价格和更低的交易概率，而不影响买方或卖方剩余。
title: Interim Information Design And Buyer-Optimal Pricing
title_zh: 临时信息设计与买方最优定价
